case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0;; esac; BMM="$PWD/_bmad/bmm/workflows"; [ -d "$BMM" ] || exit 0; START_MARK="$PWD/.claude/.session-start-main"; CUR=$(/usr/bin/git -C "$PWD" rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null || /usr/bin/git -C "$PWD" rev-parse main 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$CUR" ] && exit 0; if [ ! -f "$START_MARK" ]; then   /bin/mkdir -p "$(/usr/bin/dirname "$START_MARK")" 2>/dev/null;   /bin/echo "$CUR" > "$START_MARK" 2>/dev/null;   exit 0; fi; START=$(/bin/cat "$START_MARK" 2>/dev/null); [ "$START" = "$CUR" ] && exit 0; DEPLOY_MARK="/tmp/claude-bmad-deployed-$PPID"; [ -f "$DEPLOY_MARK" ] && exit 0; CFG="$PWD/_bmad/bmm/config.yaml"; if [ -f "$CFG" ] && /usr/bin/grep -q "bmad_contract: *skip" "$CFG"; then exit 0; fi; REMIND_MARK="$PWD/.claude/.undeployed-warn-last"; if [ -f "$REMIND_MARK" ]; then   last=$(/usr/bin/stat -f %m "$REMIND_MARK" 2>/dev/null || /usr/bin/stat -c %Y "$REMIND_MARK" 2>/dev/null || echo 0);   now=$(/bin/date +%s);   age=$((now - last));   [ "$age" -lt 900 ] && exit 0; fi; /usr/bin/touch "$REMIND_MARK" 2>/dev/null; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"UNDEPLOYED MERGE: origin/main moved since session start (was %s, now %s) but ./scripts/bmad-deploy.sh has not run this session. Run it to ship the merged changes, or document why a deploy was deliberately skipped."}}\n' "${START:0:7}" "${CUR:0:7}"
